# Alpha rules — part pickers

`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` in this file is `workflows-core`'s root, whichever plugin's run reads it.

## Rule index of `alpha`

Every rule name in `alpha`, with the part that holds it; `core` comes with every part. Load a part with `Skill(skill: "workflows-core:reference", args: "alpha <part>")`, unless it is already in this conversation word for word.

- `Choice lists are presented verbatim` → `core`
- `Closed-vocabulary pickers` → `pickers`

---

The alpha reference holds the rules a choice list follows.

## Choice lists are presented verbatim

Present every option exactly as the command wrote it.

## Closed-vocabulary pickers

A free-text answer is normalised into the picker's own vocabulary, or re-asked.
